name: Black Rain (Yakuza Gang)
body:
A yakuza who joins this gang surrenders their identity to it, becoming whatever is needed of them at the time. They are nothing except for what is needed by their gang.

Edict: The yakuza must do their best to gain new information about those around them, learning whatever they can. Secrecy is of the utmost importance to a black rain yakuza, going above and beyond in both learning and entrenching themselves in whatever social circles they can find. The true identity and purpose of a black rain yakuza must remain hidden to only themselves and their gang.

Sneak Attack: Whenever a black rain yakuza makes an attack which would qualify for sneak attack damage against a foe who is unaware of their presence or who consider them an ally, they gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls against that creature until the end of their turn.
Skills Whenever a black rain yakuza makes a Diplomacy check to influence another creature’s attitude, they gain a bonus equal to +1/3 their yakuza level (minimum 1).

Gang Abilities: A yakuza belonging to this gang gains the following abilities as they increases in level:

Friendly Shadow (Ex)

At 2nd level, a black rain yakuza is treated as though they had concealment against any foe that is unaware of them or considers them an ally.

Friendly Whispers (Su)

At 8th level, whenever a black rain yakuza makes a successful Diplomacy check to shift a foe’s attitude to friendly, they can spend 1 point from their ki to also affect the foe with a suggestion with a DC of 10 + 1/2 their yakuza level + their Charisma modifier to negate.

Friendly Slaughter (Su)

At 15th level, whenever a black rain yakuza makes an attack which would qualify for sneak attack damage against a foe who is unaware of their presence or who consider them an ally, they can spend 1 point from their ki to maximize the damage from their sneak attack dice.
